title: Real terminal review startup and child monitoring
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY and FARMSLOT_REVIEW_PROOF_RUN_ID to a live local static review. Optional FARMSLOT_REVIEW_EXPECT_BINARY, FARMSLOT_REVIEW_EXPECT_CHILD_STEPS and FARMSLOT_REVIEW_FAILED_RUN_ID pin the machine executable, checklist size and a previous failed-start attempt. Requires the real worker to mark startup and register its child; this recipe creates no task signals.

live-startup.intent: Read the production run and child progress through gateway RPC, verify its task-owned startup signal and machine executable, and reject an unacknowledged worker.
